links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses to patient dental caries questions (Ateşman index)
links.effect: ChatGPT produced the most readable texts, generally 'easy to read'; readability differed across models (ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek). For DeepSeek, higher accuracy correlated with better readability (p < 0.001).
links.quote: ChatGPT produced the most readable texts, categorized generally as "easy to read" according to the Ateşman index.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the clinical accuracy, usefulness, and readability of three commercial LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek) answering simulated patient queries regarding dental caries, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
